verdict.rationale: Fellow is an AI meeting-notes SaaS, so a commitment not to train on customer data, or an opt-out from training, is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack contains no statement about model training, a no-training policy, or a training opt-out. The privacy controls it does document (retention policies, zero-day retention, data deletion, transcript redaction, pausing recording) govern how data is stored and captured, not whether it is used to train models, so they cannot be credited here.
